title: Finance Assistant
description:
Role Overview

We are currently recruiting for a Finance Assistant - Regional Support to join a busy Finance team.

The role will provide financial and administrative support to the Finance Business Partner team and operational sites. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reviewing unit bookwork, completing reconciliations, supporting month-end processes and assisting with financial reporting.

This is a varied position suited to someone with previous finance or finance administration experience who is organised, numerate and has excellent attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities
Review unit bookwork to ensure financial information is accurate and complete.
Identify errors, discrepancies and areas for improvement.
Work with operational teams to resolve issues and improve processes.
Maintain accurate financial records, ledgers and databases.
Complete account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
Resolve or escalate financial exceptions and queries where appropriate.
Provide administrative and reporting support to the Finance Business Partner team.
Support operational sites with invoice and billing queries.
Assist with month-end and year-end close activities.
Prepare routine financial reports and assist with analysis of trends and variances.
Support financial reporting transformation projects and process improvements.
Respond to finance-related queries in a professional and timely manner.
Complete ad hoc finance and administrative duties as required.
Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience within a finance or finance administration role.
Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
Experience using financial systems or accounting software.
Experience completing reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
The ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
A proactive and reliable approach to work.
The ability to work collaboratively with both Finance and operational teams.
The ability to handle confidential financial information appropriately.
Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

Accurate and detail-focused.
Organised and reliable.
Proactive and willing to take ownership.
Numerate and analytical.
A confident communicator.
Collaborative and approachable.
Comfortable working to deadlines.
Flexible and willing to support the wider Finance team.

This role is full time office based in Warwick

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Overview:
Zenith Advisory Partners are working with a reputable and established business in Carlisle that are seeking an organised, accurate and proactive Payroll Assistant to join a busy payroll team within a leading business.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with payroll experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to develop their career within payroll. You will play a key role in ensuring their employees are paid accurately and on time, supporting payroll processing across a diverse workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
- Process, manage and maintain both the monthly payroll and Time and Attendance software accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Maintain accurate employee payroll records, including starters, leavers and amendments.
- Process overtime, allowances, deductions, and other payroll adjustments.
- Manage payroll queries from employees and managers, providing professional and timely responses.
- Complete statutory payroll requirements, including PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and statutory payments.
- Ensure all payroll changes are supported by appropriate authorisation.
- Reconcile payroll reports and investigate discrepancies.
- Liaise with HR, Finance and operational teams to resolve payroll issues.
- Support year-end processes, including P60s and other statutory reporting.
- Assist with payroll audits and continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills & Experience Required:
- Experienced in payroll administration, ideally within a high-volume payroll environment.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident working with numbers and identifying discrepancies.
- Comfortable working to tight deadlines.
- Able to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
- A strong communicator with excellent customer service skills.
- Competent using Microsoft Excel and payroll systems.
- Able to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- Keen to develop their knowledge and career within payroll.

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to £30,000, depending on experience.
- 33 days of annual leave (including bank holidays)
- Company pension - 5%
- Sick pay
- Additional leave
- Employee discount
- Health & wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Referral programme

company: H Squared Talent Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
- Full-time or part-time considered (minimum hours/week across 5 days)
- Based on-site in Carlisle
- Join a well-established, growing engineering business

Are you highly organised, great at juggling a busy workload, and someone who takes real pride in getting the details right? Do you enjoy being the person who keeps things running smoothly behind the scenes?

An established engineering business is looking for an Internal Sales Coordinator to join their fabulous team. This is a great opportunity for someone with strong administrative and organisational skills to play a valuable role within a busy sales function - no engineering knowledge needed, full training will be given.

The Role:
You'll be the first point of contact for incoming sales enquiries, keeping the sales inbox organised and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. A lot of enquiries relate to the same job or project, so a key part of the role is spotting patterns, processing repeat quotes efficiently, and making sure the technical sales team's time is spent where it matters most.

You'll also handle requests for product diagrams and quality documentation, liaise with production, and manage general, non-technical customer queries, keeping accurate records throughout, including supporting the rollout of a new CRM system.

It's a varied, fast-paced role at the heart of the business, and one where good organisation and attention to detail make a real difference.

The Candidate:

We're looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail
- Confident managing a high volume of tasks and knowing what to prioritise
- A clear, confident communicator, comfortable liaising with customers
- Comfortable using spreadsheets and databases
- Reliable, and happy to be on-site daily
- Previous experience in a sales support, admin or order-processing role is an advantage, but not essential - what matters most is your organisational ability

If you're looking for a role where your organisational skills are valued, and where you can make a visible impact on a busy team, we'd love to hear from you. Please click apply to find out more!

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Heidi Wright Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
We're looking for an organised and proactive Accounts Assistant to join a friendly finance team in a varied role offering plenty of responsibility and involvement across the day-to-day finances of the business.

Reporting to the Financial Controller, you'll take ownership of key transactional finance processes while also getting involved in cash flow forecasting, banking, reconciliations, cost analysis and wider finance support.

This would suit someone who enjoys having their own responsibilities, likes to keep things organised and accurate, and wants a role where they can make a genuine contribution rather than simply process transactions.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Taking ownership of the purchase ledger, including invoice and purchase order processing, subcontractor applications, CIS, supplier payments and monthly statement reconciliations
- Investigating invoice discrepancies and liaising with colleagues, suppliers and subcontractors to resolve queries
- Maintaining accurate accounts payable and receivable records
- Processing and reconciling employee expenses and company credit cards
- Monitoring daily bank balances, recording transactions and completing bank reconciliations
- Preparing and maintaining weekly cash flow forecasts
- Supporting the project management team with cost analysis and financial information
- Managing queries received through the Accounts and Orders inboxes
- Providing ad-hoc analysis and reporting to support the Financial Controller and wider business

About you

You'll be someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for your workload and enjoys working as part of a supportive team.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within an accounts, finance or bookkeeping role
- Good organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Strong attention to detail and pride in producing accurate work
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build good working relationships
- A practical, proactive approach and willingness to help across the finance function
- Experience using Sage and Excel would be advantageous
- Previous experience within construction, property or a project-based environment would be useful, although this is not essential

Experience of CIS or subcontractor accounting would be particularly helpful, but candidates with strong transferable accounts experience are also encouraged to apply.

What's on offer
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience
- Permanent position
- Hybrid / flexible working options
- Company pension
- On-site parking
- A varied role with genuine ownership and responsibility
- Opportunity to work closely with the Financial Controller and wider operational team
- Scope to develop your knowledge across a broader range of finance activities

A great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for a varied position where you can take ownership of your work, become an important part of the finance team and gain exposure beyond traditional transactional accounting.

title: Workflow Administrator
description: As a member of the workflow team, you will be expected to safely process, scan and code all incoming patient correspondence and clinical documentation; ensure patient records are updated accurately and reduce clinical administrative burden on the GP team; assist with stock control for clinical and administrative needs of the practice. Alongside other team members you will deal directly with all correspondence coming into the surgery and complete other administration tasks such as organising immunisation clinics, checking new patient notes and stock control. You will be using the EMIS clinical system to record patient based data and use a multitude of web based reporting and screening systems. More detail on the requirements of the role are listed in the Job Description provided. Core Duties and Responsibilities Process correspondence (paper, electronic and email) attaching it to the patient record, Accurately code diagnoses, procedures and investigations, other specific actions as per the practice protocols Fulfilling follow-up actions such as informing a GP, contacting patients to make appointments. Identify the complex or higher risk areas that require input or knowledge from clinicians (including safeguarding issues) Completing registrations (new patients), including Temporary Residents, Dealing with external patient data sources e.g. central databases for screening & immunisation status (Cervical cytology) Liaising with Hospitals, GP Surgeries, Coroner & other Government/ external departments re patients who have left or died Dealing with practice emails e.g. from the out-of-hours service (Cumbria Health), ambulance service Checking new patient notes on receipt from other GP Practices checking the summary for accuracy, notifying GP/ Dispensary team as necessary Dealing with physical notes storage and summarising of paper records Work to the agreed practice protocols Work with the workflow team and other colleagues including Primary Care Network (PCN) colleagues Contribute to identifying and acting on potential improvements Other general admin tasks e.g. dealing with the post & franking machine, shredding confidential documents, filing, printing, producing documents and any other admin tasks as needed IT Systems Record patient-related data in our clinical system, Emis Web Use web-based reporting systems/ data base systems e.g. PHE reporting, screening & immunisations systems Use email both for own emails and for generic practice emails Assist with the updating of the practice website Create social media accounts and policies ensuring safe use of social media platforms. Post health information and updates to practice social media accounts as needed The post holder will work with other workflow administrators to prioritise, plan and action tasks and report directly to the practice manager. The post holder must maintain the confidentiality of information about patients, staff and organisation business in accordance with the Caldicott principles and with legal obligations under the Data Protection Act 2018 (the 2018 Act) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in respect of data privacy and security. Further details will be provided in the form of practice policies to successful applicants. All employees have a duty for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults at risk. Staff must be familiar with Cumbria Health Safeguarding Policy and the process for raising concerns about the welfare of anyone with whom they have contact. Staff must also ensure they receive the appropriate level of safeguarding children and adult training depending on their role.

title: Ward Clerk
company: North Cumbria Integrated Care NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: North Cumbria Integrated Care NHS Foundation Trust
description: Provide support in the Integrated Pathways Care Group for all clerical and administrative duties, organising and prioritising day to day workload within the Elective care suite. Undertake general clerical duties including completing records, filing, photocopying, handling mail and filing in case notes in the clinical areas. Provide an accurate account of bed management e.g. admissions, transfers and discharges. Input and extract details / information from the computerised patient administration system (PAS), ensuring all patient episodes, admissions, transfers and discharge are recorded accurately onto PAS and in a timely manner. Keep all manual book records up to date daily e.g. ward register etc. Complete patient discharges, filing all relevant case notes and forward them to the coding department.. Be competent in the use of Electronic Patient Records (EPR) Send / deliver completed discharges to coding ensuring that all relevant reports and paperwork are filed correctly according to the Trust order of filing. Liaise with nursing staff with regards to patient enquiries, ensuring that patient confidentiality is maintained at all times. Answer the telephone/entrance door, relaying any relevant messages when required. Book any appointments needed for patients. Liaise with the other departments to arrange follow-up appointments as required. Track case notes.
